channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: Google Research releases Harness², open-source agent harness optimizer
item.description: Google Research open-sourced Harness² under Apache 2.0: a framework that improves AI agents by iteratively rewriting the harness around a fixed model, targeting teams that cannot or will not retrain weights.

item.title: NVIDIA's new open models push agents onto enterprise servers and local PCs
item.description: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Bolt family targets local agentic work: a 74B-A9B model for multistep tool calling on a single machine, plus a smaller E4B conversational model due later this month, alongside the multimodal Super VL.

item.title: NVIDIA Ships New Open-Weight Models for Agents, Including a 24 GB Bolt
item.description: NVIDIA's new open-weight Nemotron family for agents, including the Bolt 74B-A9B model tuned to run in 24 GB of memory for local agentic workloads.

item.title: VS Code 1.142, OpenCode 2.0, Codex CLI 0.163: October's coding-agent release roundup
item.description: A single timeline of October's coding-agent releases: VS Code 1.142 shipping Copilot agent host policies, OpenCode 2.0's background service and API, plus updates from Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

item.title: WoW Forever watch: beta ends Oct 21, launch countdown at Nov 4
item.description: Datamine-checked rundown of the Classic+ launch: beta closes Oct 21, name reservations Oct 27 to Nov 3, then a permanent level-60 Azeroth with Skyborne elves and Undead Paladins on Nov 4.

item.title: Idea Harness v0.7.0: safer AI coding with verifiable changes
item.description: The coding-agent harness ships v0.7.0 built around verifiable, human-approved code changes, following the v0.6.0 release with its editable planning graph, secret detection, and git-native commits.

item.title: Running a local LLM on iPad and Android tablet in 2026, Termux route included
item.description: Fresh rundown of the phone/tablet on-device stack: Termux + Ollama remains the full-ecosystem path on Android, while PocketPal AI and Google AI Edge Gallery (both updated 2026-10-16) are the no-terminal alternatives; Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Dimensity 9300 hold ~15-25 tok/s on 1.7B models.

item.title: Local LLM inference optimization guide: Oct 18 update
item.description: Rolling benchmark guide refreshed Oct 18 with new findings: Q8_0 PLE decode up 31.7% at 0 VRAM, dynamic per-expert VRAM caching hitting 74.8 tok/s at 128k, and Gated-DeltaNet holding 262k context on a 12GB card.

item.title: Sentinel-IR on Android: install it in Termux and verify the output
item.description: Step-by-step walkthrough installing the sentinel-ir 0.1.1 JS analysis package in Termux, running its WASM parser, and verifying the JSON output on a phone.

item.title: DeepLearning.AI adds free browser-based agentic coding lab
item.description: DeepLearning.AI folded a browser-based agentic coding lab with live preview into its on-device memory course, free to enroll with no installs.

item.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
item.description: Google Research open-sourced a framework that improves the eight harness components around a frozen model (prompts, tools, memory, subagents, skills); a single refinement step lifted several agent setups on their benchmarks.

item.title: vLLM 0.32.0 adds structured decisions and a system-level endpoint
item.description: vLLM 0.32.0 lands with a structured-decisions feature and a new systemone endpoint for system-level inference control, per the olud.ai daily tracker.

item.title: ALIEN RPG Evolved Edition launches on Foundry VTT
item.description: Free League's ALIEN RPG Evolved Edition core rules, starter set, and Rapture Protocol arrive as premium Foundry VTT modules with integrated rules and automation.

item.title: Gemma 3 4B QAT-int4 checkpoint re-quantized into GGUF for local desktops
item.description: DevQuasar's new Modelers.cn release takes Google's official QAT int4 Gemma 3 4B instruct checkpoint and re-quantizes it into GGUF, claiming better quality than plain post-training quants at the same width for laptop-class llama.cpp setups.

item.title: Flow-Judge v0.1 Lands on Modelers.cn as a Tiny, Local LLM Judge — With a Few Caveats
item.description: A community GGUF build of Flow-Judge v0.1 — a 3.8B model fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a locally runnable LLM-as-a-judge for scoring AI and RAG outputs; note it's a third-party quant on Huawei's Modelers.cn hub, not an official release.

item.title: Run Google's Gemma 3 1B Locally: A New GGUF Release on Modelers.cn
item.description: A third-party GGUF conversion of Google's quantization-aware-trained Gemma 3 1B int4 checkpoint, packaged so the tiny model runs on CPU via llama.cpp-compatible stacks; quality should beat plain post-training quants at the same size.

item.title: A 27B Qwen Open-Weight Build in int4 ONNX for Local Inference
item.description: A 27B Qwen-family open-weight build packaged as int4 ONNX, targeting local inference on Windows, Linux, CPU, GPU, and NPU backends.

item.title: Ornith-1.0-9B GGUF lands on Modelers.cn for local inference
item.description: Community-built GGUF quant of the obscure 9B Ornith-1.0 model, packaged for llama.cpp, Ollama, and LM Studio on consumer hardware.

item.title: Meta's 950M MobileLLM-R1 base model gets a GGUF build
item.description: Sub-1B MobileLLM-R1 checkpoint (2T training tokens) converted to GGUF, small enough to run on laptops and edge devices without a GPU.

item.title: GitLab 19.5: the governed agentic software factory
item.description: GitLab 19.5 leans into agentic development with an MCP server letting external coding agents run GitLab Duo workflows, plus a new Secrets Manager for pipeline jobs and early access to an agent-oriented SCM architecture.

item.title: SmolLM-135M packaged for AMD Ryzen AI 1.7 hybrid NPU execution
item.description: A 135M-parameter SmolLM instruct build repackaged as ONNX aimed at AMD Ryzen AI 1.7 hybrid-NPU laptops, a niche few local models serve; the listing is a bare mirror of the upstream release, so check AMD docs for the runtime recipe.

item.title: JetBrains Mellum 2.1: 12B Apache-2.0 MoE coding model you can self-host
item.description: JetBrains shipped Mellum 2.1, a 12B-total / 2.5B-active mixture-of-experts coding model under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face; RL post-training inside real repos took SWE-bench Verified from 2.0 to 47.0, with GGUF builds for local inference.

item.title: Google Research open-sources Harness², a recursive self-refining agent harness
item.description: Google Research open-sourced Harness², a 100% open-source framework where the agent rewrites its own harness (prompt, tools, memory, skills) per task via propose-probe-compose, improving scores by up to 11.8 points per round without ground truth.

item.title: Schematron-3B GGUF lands on Modelers.cn
item.description: A ~3B text-generation model from 'inference-net' got a CPU-friendly GGUF conversion from DevQuasar and a mirror on Modelers.cn — roughly a 2-3 GB footprint at 4-bit, sized for edge experiments and quick local prototyping.

item.title: WoW Forever unveiled at BlizzCon 2026: horizontal Classic+ expansion detailed
item.description: BlizzCon 2026 reveal positions WoW Forever as a permanent third branch: revamped and new zones, three raids, a new battleground, and the Skyborne elves at level 60.

item.title: Open Source AI Weekly: Five Developments to Watch, October 9-15
item.description: Weekly roundup of open-source AI for Oct 9-15, including Cloudflare's open-weight multimodal decision model Clef-omni and what weights-without-cheap-hardware means for local evaluation.

item.title: OpenCode 2.0: 75+ AI Models, One API Key
item.description: OpenCode 2.0 ships background-service execution plus a new API and SDK, model-agnostic across 75+ providers, stacked against Claude Code 2.1.302 and Codex CLI 0.162.0 October releases.

item.title: IBM Granite 3.0 2B base lands on Modelers.cn as a third-party GGUF
item.description: Community GGUF conversion of IBM's Apache-2.0 Granite 3.0 2B base model so it runs offline via llama.cpp on laptops, edge boxes and tight memory budgets; completion-style base, so best as a fine-tuning or completion starting point rather than a chat assistant.

item.title: Best small LLMs 2026: top 4B models that actually run locally
item.description: Freshly refreshed roundup of small 2B-4B open models for laptops, phones and air-gapped boxes, with licensing notes and per-model hardware guidance.

item.title: IBM Granite 3.2 8B Instruct lands in GGUF for offline inference
item.description: Third-party GGUF build of IBM's 8B instruction-tuned Granite 3.2 (preview) published on Modelers.cn, aimed at laptop and edge use via llama.cpp-class runtimes; model card is sparse and provenance is unverified.

item.title: IBM Granite 8B Code with 128K context gets a local GGUF build
item.description: A community GGUF conversion of IBM's Granite 8B Code base model, notable for pairing an 8B parameter count with a claimed 128K-token context window for local codebase-scale work; long-context quality is unverified.

item.title: Open-RS2: tiny 1.5B reasoning model lands in GGUF
item.description: A 1.5B reasoning model in GGUF from the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B line with an open GRPO recipe, built for offline laptop experimentation.

item.title: Kyutai's Helium-1 2B arrives as GGUF on Modelers.cn
item.description: DevQuasar packaged Kyutai's compact multilingual Helium-1 2B in GGUF, making it a one-click download for llama.cpp, Ollama, and LM Studio users.

item.title: ServiceNow launches EmployeeWorks no-code agent platform
item.description: ServiceNow launched EmployeeWorks, a no-code platform letting employees build their own agents, with a ToolSmith dev environment and pre-built research and scheduling assistants.

item.title: Codex Harness open-sourced by OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI open-sourced the Codex Harness execution layer (Apache-2.0), the agent core behind Codex, so teams can embed its task understanding, tool calling, and human-approval loop in their own software.

item.title: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3.5 Bolt open models for local AI agents
item.description: Nvidia released two open-weight Bolt models for local agents: a 74B-A9B MoE fitting 24GB via 2-bit quantization, out now on Hugging Face with Ollama and llama.cpp support, plus a 4GB E4B model due Oct. 23.

item.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG + Unstoppable Project Update: Foundry has joined the party
item.description: Renegade announces Foundry VTT as a pledge option alongside Fantasy Grounds, Roll20, and Alchemy for the Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG, with an October 2026 VTT launch and the bundle free for top-tier backers.

item.title: Phi-4 Mini Reasoning in GGUF: a 3.8B local reasoner lands on Modelers.cn
item.description: Community GGUF repack of Microsoft's 3.8B Phi-4-mini-reasoning puts the MIT-licensed reasoning model on llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio at roughly 4-8 GB RAM; a third-party repack, not an official Microsoft release.

item.title: NVIDIA releases Dory1.0-4B: looped latent-recurrent open-weight model with GGUF builds
item.description: NVIDIA published Dory1.0-4B on October 16, a 4B looped (latent-recurrent) model whose shared layer block re-runs per token to trade compute for quality, with 256K context and official GGUF builds for local inference.

item.title: NVIDIA Dory1.0-4B: 4B reasoning model with adjustable inference loops
item.description: NVIDIA's October 16 release of a 4B reasoning and coding model where you dial compute per token by changing loop counts without retraining; published with BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF builds plus vLLM and llama.cpp recipes.
